title: ui.md file-name rule conflicts with the CLI render file names now written straight into renders/

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261128-002826-1170e384 for S660 (discovered from S660):

ui.md file-name rule conflicts with the CLI render file names now written straight into renders/
`internal/roles/prompts/ui.md:75-81` still asks for `VIEW-80x24.txt`, `VIEW-120x40.txt` and `VIEW-ascii.txt` files. The CLI command now writes `status.txt`, `show.txt` and so on straight into the renders directory (`brief.go:239`), and the brief says the card lists every `.txt`. The prompt and the brief now disagree about naming for CLI views. The old copy step under VIEW names kept them in line, and adj 667 removed it. Also, the defaults alone write 5 + 15 = 20 files. With `-render-fixture` the count can pass `maxRenders = 24` (`internal/engine/approval.go:405`), and the card drops the rest. Neither the brief nor the prompt warns about this. PLAUSIBLE as to harm.
Importance: 2
Urgency: 1
Effort: 1
